MOON_SHACKLETON_RIM.name: Shackleton Crater Rim (Artemis South Pole Base)
MOON_SHACKLETON_RIM.mission_focus: ISRU Water Mining & Peaks of Eternal Light Power
MOON_SHACKLETON_RIM.description: Kalici golgeli krater tabaninda su buzu (ISRU) ve sirtlarinda kesintisiz gunes isigi sunan birincil Artemis us adayi.

MOON_MARE_TRANQUILLITATIS_PIT.name: Mare Tranquillitatis Skylight Pit (Lava Tube Base)
MOON_MARE_TRANQUILLITATIS_PIT.description: 100 metre derinliginde cokmus bazaltik lav tupu girisi. Radyasyon ve mikrometeoritlerden korunan yeralti ussu adayi.

MOON_MARIUS_HILLS.name: Marius Hills Volcanic Complex & Skylight
MOON_MARIUS_HILLS.mission_focus: Volcanic Regolith ISRU (3D Printing) & Subsurface Access
MOON_MARIUS_HILLS.description: Ay'in en yogun volkanik kubbe ve lav kanali bolgesi. Bazaltik regolitten 3B baski ile us insasi icin ideal.

MARS_ARCADIA_PLANITIA.name: Arcadia Planitia (Human Landing & Ice ISRU Base)
MARS_ARCADIA_PLANITIA.primary_process: Periglacial Shallow Subsurface Ice Sheet & Volcanic Plains
MARS_ARCADIA_PLANITIA.mission_focus: Starship Heavy Landing & Shallow Water-Ice Drilling (ISRU)
MARS_ARCADIA_PLANITIA.description: Duz bazaltik ova ve yuzeyin 1-2 metre altinda devasa su buzu tabakasi barindiran birincil insanli Mars us adayi.

MARS_JEZERO_CRATER.name: Jezero Crater Paleo-Lake Delta (Astrobiology Base)
MARS_JEZERO_CRATER.mission_focus: Astrobiology Biosignature Search & Autonomous Rover Traverse
MARS_JEZERO_CRATER.description: Eski nehir deltasi, magnezyum karbonat, evaporit tuzlar ve kil mineralleri iceren krater havzasi.

MARS_ARSIA_MONS_CAVES.name: Arsia Mons 'Seven Sisters' Skylights (Martian Subsurface Base)
MARS_ARSIA_MONS_CAVES.primary_process: Flank Volcano Lava Tube Collapse & High-Altitude Aridity
MARS_ARSIA_MONS_CAVES.mission_focus: Subsurface Radiation Shelter & Cave Robotics Exploration
MARS_ARSIA_MONS_CAVES.description: Arsia Mons volkaninin yamacinda yer alan derin yeralti lav tupu ve magara girisleri.
